title: Project Website Product Front Door Design Spec v1 — Rig Relay
status: design_spec — do not implement until reviewed. Implementation deferred to website-build slice.

product_positioning.one_sentence: Rig Relay is a governed operating layer for AI-assisted development — an authority spine and evidence substrate that makes coding agents observable, controlled, and reviewable.
hero_headlines: Govern Your Coding Agents. Keep the Receipts.
The Operating Layer for AI-Assisted Development.
Make Every Agent Decision Observable, Controlled, and Reviewable.
product_positioning.subhead: Rig Relay gives you a desktop cockpit, hardened MCP tool surface, CLI governance gates, and receipt-backed evidence so your coding agents work for you — not the other way around.
what_rig_relay_is: A local-first governed agent runtime with a desktop cockpit
An authority spine that gates every tool, mutation, and surface
An evidence substrate that produces receipt-backed, schema-governed JSON/JSONL/CSV artifacts
A hardened MCP server exposing read-only governance tools to Antigravity, Claude, VS Code, and Zed
A CLI and script mutation gate that requires explicit --execute with approval receipts
A DuckDB/Postgres projection layer for governance analytics
A roadmap steward that ranks work slices and coordinates agent lanes
what_rig_relay_is_not: Not an autonomous coding agent — Rig Relay governs agents, it is not an agent itself
Not an LLM API wrapper — it is an operating layer between agents and tools
Not a CI/CD pipeline — it produces evidence artifacts, not deployment artifacts
Not enterprise-ready — 7 P0 procurement blockers remain
Not a hosted SaaS — local-first, with hosted path planned but not implemented

AI coding agents change code at speed that outpaces human review. Without governance, every agent call is an untraceable mutation. Rig Relay gives you the authority spine you need to say: 'Here's what the agent did, here's the receipt, here's the governance decision.'

product_pillar_cards.headline: Every agent action gated.
product_pillar_cards.body: Agent governance is not advisory — it is enforced. Patch gating, dirty-file preservation, tool permission tiers, council consultation, and approval receipts are system-level controls, not suggestions.

product_pillar_cards.headline: One spine. Every surface.
product_pillar_cards.body: Cockpit, CLI, MCP, ACP, WebSocket — one authority model governs all. No surface is exempt. Every mutation requires evidence.

product_pillar_cards.headline: Every decision recorded.
product_pillar_cards.body: ReceiptEnvelope evidence with governance_decision_id, content-light classification, surface, authority tier, and capability ID. Replayable, auditable, schema-governed.

product_pillar_cards.headline: Read-only MCP is not unfenced read.
product_pillar_cards.body: Descriptor integrity, roots boundary, content-light scanning, receipt persistence, local session auth, tier authorization. 94/94 gate tests pass. No mutation tools exposed.

product_pillar_cards.headline: Scripts are governed too.
product_pillar_cards.body: Every mutating script must default to dry-run or require --execute with approval receipt. CLI governance guard integrated. 59/59 tests pass.

product_pillar_cards.headline: Code scanning, PR mutation, lifecycle.
product_pillar_cards.body: GitHub App permission posture documented. Live PR rehearsal. Code scanning alert integration. Trust Spine roadmap exists for cryptographic mutation enforcement.

product_pillar_cards.headline: Query your governance data.
product_pillar_cards.body: DuckDB read-side analytics over JSONL evidence. Postgres operational projection planned for enterprise mode. High-performance substrate doctrine exists.

product_pillar_cards.headline: Your roadmap has a steward.
product_pillar_cards.body: Read-only coordination agent. Ranks slices. Detects collisions. Produces bounded prompts for worker agents. Never mutates. Never self-approves.

trust_pipeline_steps.copy: Agent proposes action via cockpit, CLI, or MCP. Intent is captured as a structured request with surface, capability, and authority tier.
GovernanceRuntime evaluates against session rules, tool permissions, and authority spine tier. Decision is typed, not boolean.
Context assembly with trust tier labeling. Content SHA256-hashed. No raw file contents in context envelope.
Tool execution behind runtime boundary. Environment scrubbing, bash pattern detection, binary rejection, symlink protection, patch gating.
ReceiptEnvelope produced for every tool call and governance decision. Merkle-linked. Content-light. Schema-governed.
Targeted release gates verify hardening. MCP gate: 94/94. CLI gate: 59/59. Schema validation: all pass.
DuckDB read-side analytics project governance decisions. Postgres operational projection planned for enterprise mode.
Receipt manifests, governance decision projections, release gate results. JSON/JSONL/CSV source-of-truth. Generated docs/pages/ with 400+ schemas.

visual_direction.aesthetic: Serious control-plane. Graphite/dark neutral base (#1a1a2e, #16213e, #0f3460) with teal/accent highlights (#00b4d8). Evidence rail/cards with subtle borders. Status chips: green (implemented), amber (partial), blue (planned), grey (deferred).
visual_direction.typography: System font stack. Mono for code/evidence references. Readable line-height (1.6), comfortable measure (65ch max).
visual_direction.layout: Single-column, max-width 900px, centered. Sections separated by thin rule (1px, low-opacity graphite). No sidebars on product pages. Evidence/docs layer keeps its existing layout.
visual_direction.anti_patterns: No gradient hero spam. No terminal-emulator cosplay. No particle effects. No generic SaaS template. No stock photography of people typing at laptops.
